messages:
maria (docs): hey team — quick sync. I opened a small PR to: 1) add a short 'provisioning playbook' that cross-links the Dedicated onboarding checklist with the isolation guide, and 2) include a compact SDK snippet for tenant labels + isolation decorator. CI is failing lint and there are two broken links. can someone help triage?

sam (infra): pinging @carla and @jordan — i can take the broken links. which ones are 404ing?

maria (docs): thanks. In the PR description I call them out — links to the legacy terraform snippet and to an old scalepolicy page. both 404. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4287 (small branch: docs/provisioning-playbook-wireup)

jordan (eng): i saw the CI logs — lint errors are from the new YAML snippet not matching our code block style (we require explicit language tag). also the SDK example uses the old python client import path.

carla (platform): i can update the terraform link to the new handbook path. for the scalepolicy doc, that moved under /guides/autoscale/v2 — i'll create a redirect.

maria (docs): ideal. can we also tighten the SDK example so it shows both python and go minimal usage? people like tiny copiable examples.

sam (infra): here's a tiny Python snippet that should be safe to paste (use triple backticks in the doc):

```python
from redwood import InferenceClient
client = InferenceClient()
resp = client.create_dedicated_provisioning(tenant_label="team-foo", isolation="isolated")
print(resp)
```

sam (infra): and a Go variant i used in recent onboarding: 

```go
import "github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk"
client := sdk.NewClient(nil)
_, err := client.ProvisionDedicated(&sdk.ProvisionOptions{TenantLabel: "team-foo", Isolation: "isolated"})
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
```

jordan (eng): thanks. i'll open a tiny patch to update the import path and add language tags on code fences. also found one doc heading that used H2 where we prefer H3 in the playbook — i'll fix that for consistency.

maria (docs): perfect. carla, do you want me to add a short migration checklist bullet: "If you relied on legacy scalepolicy, switch to v2 and validate cooldowns"? it's one line but saves churn for SREs.

carla (platform): yes please, add a short checklist and an explicit test: create a reserved pool, set scalePolicy.v2 with cooldown 30s, run the smoke script, verify no preemption during cooldown. add the smoke script link to the playbook.

maria (docs): will do. i'll patch the PR today with: link fixes, code fence tags, python+go snippets, the one-line migration checklist, and a note pointing at the isolation runbook. after that can someone approve? hoping to ship before EOD. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

docs-bot: PR #4287 status update — checks: lint (failed), link-check (failed), build (pending)

sam (infra): after jordan's import-fix commit and my link update, run the link-check again. i can re-run CI once the branch updates.

jordan (eng): pushed two tiny commits: (1) import path fix, (2) added ```yaml tags.

maria (docs): pushed the playbook bullet + smoke script link. i also added a one-liner in the SDK note about tenant_label format: "use kebab-case, max 32 chars".

carla (platform): i updated the redirect for the old scalepolicy URL. link-check should be green now after sam re-runs.

sam (infra): re-run kicked off. looks good, link-check passed. lint still has a single nit: heading capitalization on the playbook TOC. i'll approve after that tiny change.

maria (docs): fixed the TOC capitalization. thanks everyone. merging once CI is green. :tada: 

carla (platform): can we add a short note in the playbook about when to choose "isolated" vs "shared" pools? i'm adding an example: "isolated for regulated workloads or guaranteed tenancy; shared for best cost-efficiency."

maria (docs): lovely, added that as a later paragraph in the playbook (keeps it out of the quick checklist). final CI green — merging now.

docs-bot: PR #4287 merged by maria (docs) — checks all passed. 

maria (docs): thanks all. follow-up task: port the two tiny SDK snippets into the quickstart templates repo next week. i'll open an issue.

jordan (eng): noted — i'll help wire the Go snippet into the sample app.

carla (platform): closing the loop, added a small telemetry event to track provisioning sample usage so we can see if teams copy the snippet.

maria (docs): awesome. thread resolved.
